text.tspan: Moving EC2 to another region = build a copy, sync data, cut over DNS
Regional things that DON'T move: AMI, EBS snapshot, security group, key pair, Elastic IP, subnet IDs, ARNs.
Stateless server → AMI or rebuild from launch template (≈0 downtime). Changing data → continuous replication (MGN,
DB replica, promote) so the cutover is minutes. Check instance-type availability and quotas in the new region.
